name: Open DataRoom
description: The document-sharing app your AI employee runs. It sends trackable links, watches who reads what page by page, and messages you when a visit matters. Email gates, allow lists, passcodes, watermarks, NDAs and expiry per link; branded data rooms with folders; visit notifications delivered straight to your agent. An open-source alternative to DocSend.

deploy.title: Deploy your Open DataRoom
deploy.subtitle: Your agent sends the links, tracks every page read, and tells you when it matters.
